rows.title: Full Disk Access
rows.why: Reads your repositories' git state so the daemon can show branch and MR status.

rows.optionalNote: Installed by Install (plugins.install).
rows.title: Login Items
rows.why: Lets mattstack.app start automatically and stay running in the background.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; you'll see menu-bar badges instead.
rows.title: Notifications
rows.why: Shows menu-bar notifications when something needs your attention.

rows.title: macOS version
rows.why: rt and mattstack.app require macOS 14 or newer.

rows.title: Command Line Tools
rows.why: Provides git and the other command-line build tools rt depends on.

rows.title: Processor
rows.why: mattstack ships an Apple-silicon (arm64) build; Intel Macs are not supported.

rows.title: PATH precedence
rows.why: Makes sure your shell finds rt's shims and team intercepts before any conflicting binary.
rows.detail: Install adds ~/.local/bin to your PATH in ~/.zshenv

rows.optionalNote: Works without this. Connect a GitHub or GitLab account later to open PRs and MRs from rt.
rows.title: GitHub
rows.why: Lets rt open PRs, check CI status, and read repo metadata on GitHub.
rows.detail: Signed in through the gh CLI

rows.title: herdr
rows.why: Drives Herdr panes for remote-control and multi-agent workflows.

rows.title: Claude Code
rows.why: Runs the agent sessions rt drives and hands work off to.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; only the browser skills need it.
rows.title: Fast Browser
rows.why: Backs rt's macro-first browser automation.

rows.optionalNote: You load this into Chrome yourself; Install cannot do it for you.
rows.title: Fast Browser extension
rows.why: Fast Browser drives your real Chrome session through this extension.
rows.detail: Google Chrome is not installed, so there is nothing to load it into

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; rt just won't have an editor to open files in.
rows.title: Editor
rows.why: Lets rt open the rt-context extension and hand files off to an editor.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this unless your pack declares chrome.required.
rows.title: Google Chrome
rows.why: Fast Browser and any Chrome-based pack tools drive Chrome directly.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; only matters if Control+Up doesn't reach rt's nav picker.
rows.title: Mission Control shortcut
rows.why: rt's nav picker uses Control+Up, which macOS binds to Mission Control by default.
rows.detail: Control+Up opens Mission Control, and rt's picker needs it

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; apps serve on their ports meanwhile.
rows.title: Local proxy
rows.why: Serves apps on .localhost/.mattstack domains instead of raw ports.
rows.detail: This build has no local proxy installer, so apps serve on their own ports

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; `rt state backup` is what needs them.

action.label: Show steps…
steps: Update mattstack.app; it ships age, zstd and git-lfs
Or install them yourself: brew install age zstd git-lfs

rows.title: State backup tools
rows.why: Encrypted state backup compresses with zstd, encrypts with age, and ships the result through git-lfs.

rows.optionalNote: Installed by Install (plugins.install).
rows.title: Claude plugins
rows.why: rt's skills, Fast Browser's and rt chat's all reach Claude Code as marketplace plugins.
rows.detail: Not installed: mattstack@mattstack, fast-browser@mattstack, chat@mattstack, superpowers@claude-plugins-official

rows.title: Writing style
rows.why: How the reviews, replies and PR descriptions agents post under your name read. Without one they read like an AI assistant.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; only the skills that read Linear tickets need it.
rows.title: Linear MCP
rows.why: Skills that read and update Linear tickets reach them through this MCP server.

rows.title: Agent integrations
rows.why: The agent apps rt sets up and hands work to.

rows.title: rt binary
rows.why: rt itself must be on PATH before anything else can run.

rows.optionalNote: Cosmetic: without this, `rt` may resolve to a different copy on PATH than the one inside mattstack.app.
rows.title: rt PATH link
rows.why: Prod mode's ~/.local/bin/rt must point at the rt inside mattstack.app.
rows.detail: Not a link into mattstack.app. Run rt deps link rt

rows.title: Legacy state dirs
rows.why: rt reads only ~/.mattstack/rt, so a leftover legacy dir means state is split and silently ignored.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; team command intercepts (git, gh, …) just won't fire.
rows.title: Intercept shims
rows.why: Team command intercepts (git, gh, …) only fire once their PATH shims are installed and current.
rows.detail: Not needed: your team has no intercepts

rows.title: mattstack.app
rows.why: The tray app hosts the daemon, permissions, and every bundled tool.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; the rt-context editor extension just won't be pre-installed for you.
rows.title: Bundled extension
rows.why: mattstack.app can carry the rt-context editor extension pre-bundled.
rows.detail: This build does not ship the extension

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; your editor just won't have rt-aware context.
rows.title: rt-context extension
rows.why: Gives your editor rt-aware context.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; you can still run `rt cd` directly, just not the `rtcd` shell alias.
rows.title: Shell integration
rows.why: The rtcd alias and PATH precedence come from your shell rc file.
rows.detail: rt does not know this shell, so add the rtcd alias yourself

rows.optionalNote: Installed by Install (plugins.install).
rows.title: Daemon
rows.why: The daemon watches your repos and backs MRs and notifications.

rows.title: Flavor coherence
rows.why: One app serves this machine; a daemon of the other app means stale code answering fresh CLIs.

rows.optionalNote: Works without this; local-only just means this machine is the only copy of your settings.
rows.title: Home repo backup
rows.why: Local-only is fully supported; this only confirms whether your settings are actually backed up anywhere, not just committed on this machine.
rows.detail: No home repo yet, so nothing is backed up
